Check out this incredible artwork for George R. R. Martin’s Game of Thrones universe by Chase Stone. His work has been featured in several books, including The Rise of the Dragon, Gods of Thrones, and The World of Ice & Fire.

As a freelance illustrator and concept artist, Stone’s sci-fi and fantasy portfolio covers everything from editorial pieces to major film projects.
